name: literal and text range arms share a match
source:

  "300".."303" => "north georgia"
  "303" => "atlanta"
  "304".."320" => "southeast"
  _ => "elsewhere"
}

name: a property varies a freight class over its range, one class a step
tests:
tariff "t"
let cls = shipment.freightClass ?? Class50
charge "x" = $1 * cls.number
property "lighter classes never bill less" {
  vary shipment.freightClass in Class50..=Class100
  expect total nondecreasing in shipment.freightClass
}

name: graduated distance tiers bill each part at its tier's rate
graduated weight tiers price per hundredweight
source:
tariff "t"
use std.tiers.{ WeightTier, byWeight }
input tiers: List<WeightTier> = [
  { from: 0 lb, rate: $40/cwt },
  { from: 500 lb, rate: $30/cwt },
]
charge "Linehaul" = byWeight(tiers, shipment.weight ?? 0 lb)

name: graduated tiers with none to price by refuse to rate
source:
tariff "t"
use std.tiers.{ DistanceTier, byDistance }
input mileTiers: List<DistanceTier> = []
charge "Linehaul" = byDistance(mileTiers, shipment.distance)

refusal.message: There are no distance tiers to price 250 mi with
